options.name: name
options.description: Name of the jail. This must be a unique ID.

options.name: packages
options.description: List of packages to install when the jail is created. Each entry can be either a port (e.g., C(lang/python39)), a package (e.g., C(python39)), or a specific version of a package (e.g., C(python39-3.9.16_2)).

options.name: release
options.description: Name of FreeBSD release to base this jail on. Required when creating a jail.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the jail should exist or not. If 'absent', the jail will be removed. If 'present', the jail will be created if it doesn't exist, but will not be started. 'running' and 'stopped' allow you to make sure the jail is up or down. 'restarted' will restart the jail, similar to rebooting it.
